$comment: Advisories the release gate may pass despite severity >= high. Each entry MUST say why it is safe and MUST expire, so acceptance is re-reviewed rather than forgotten. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails on any high/critical advisory not listed here, and on any listed entry past its expiry.

accepted.reason: DoS via malformed JXL/HEIF images. Reached only through metro (the React Native BUILD-TIME bundler), which parses images from this repository's own assets, never attacker-supplied input, and ships nothing to users. The fix is image-size 2.x, a semver-major that metro 0.84 (pinned by Expo 56) does not accept.
DoS via malformed ICNS images. Same build-time-only reachability and same blocked fix path as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.

Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections. The API, the shared package and the app now resolve zod 4.6.7 (patched, 2026-10-25). The one affected copy left is zod 3.25.76 inside @expo/cli, the developer CLI, which validates this repository's own config files at build time: Node-only, not in the app bundle, never given attacker input. npm's only offered fix is a different Expo major. Short expiry: re-check when Expo updates its CLI.

Quadratic slowdown on many distinct percent-encoded runs plus a malformed escape. In the APP bundle (expo-router 56 -> query-string 7 -> decode-uri-component 0.2.2), reached when a zeno:// link is opened; not in the API or the website. Measured 2026-11-17 on the advisory's payload shape, on a desktop: 20 KB 15 ms, 78 KB 230 ms, 313 KB 5.2 s. The worst a hostile link can do is freeze the app on the device of the person who taps it, until it recovers or is restarted; nothing is read, written or sent. The fixed 0.5.1 is ESM-only and query-string 7 requires() it, so it cannot be forced in; the fix path is expo-router 58 (an Expo SDK upgrade). Re-check at the next SDK upgrade.
